children: UAE stock markets closed slightly lower on Friday, reversing early gains after an adviser to Iran's leader warned of potential disruptions to regional air travel and airport services.
Iranian adviser Mokhber said if Iran cannot have flights and receive airport services, then no one in the region can either, Nournews reported on Friday.
Meanwhile, flights to and from Iran have been suspended at all four Iraqi airports — Baghdad, Najaf, Erbil and Sulaimaniya — that had been handling the routes, according to sources and state media.

Oil prices fell more than 1% on Friday as markets weighed the possibility of a truce between the US and Iran against concerns that increasing attacks against Saudi Arabia by Houthi fighters could disrupt supply from the key Middle Eastern producer.
Brent crude (LCOC1) was down 1.5% at $105 a barrel by 1141 GMT.
